controlChangeCommands.name: Remote Tap
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory External Tap Tempo. Any value taps LFO rate (SA249 C4 Synth User Guide MIDI map).

controlChangeCommands.name: Remote Expr
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory External Expression Control. Parameter targets assigned in Neuro Editor.

controlChangeCommands.name: On/Off
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Engage/Bypass. Manual body: 0–63 bypass, 64–127 engage (table text says 0–64 / 65–127).

controlChangeCommands.name: Recall Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Preset Recall (Off). CC value 0–127 selects preset (Neuro display 1–128); recalls bypassed. Prefer Program Change when available.

controlChangeCommands.name: Recall Engage
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Preset Recall (On). CC value 0–127 selects preset (Neuro display 1–128); recalls engaged. Prefer Program Change when available.

controlChangeCommands.name: Toggle Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Engage/Bypass Toggle. Any value toggles engage/bypass.
